doula.definition: n an assistant (often the father of the soon-to-be-born child) who provides support for a woman in labor by encouraging her to use techniques learned in childbirth-preparation classes
doula.translation: 产妇陪护（给产妇以心理支持）

doulle flow tray.translation: [化] 双流塔板; 双流塔盘

doulton.translation: a. (陶器)道尔顿工厂制造的
